name: @arena/intervention
description: Arena live human intervention mode domain core (Work Order C007; issue #114; spec/expert-escalation-api.md ES1.0 escalation modes + spec/expert-environment-session.md EES1.0 session modes). Typed mapping from the eight approved ES1.0 escalation modes onto the six EES1.0 session-mode policies enforced by C006, mode-authorization guards (permitted modes come from the EscalationRequest; an unlisted mode is a typed fail-closed rejection, never a silent coercion), the escalation-modes law (a request may transition between modes only through explicit lifecycle state and authorization), per-mode typed result contracts in the house verdict style (CORRECT correction patch with before/after evidence refs, UNBLOCK exactly-the-missing-information with provenance, SOLVE completed-subproblem result with evidence bundle, REVIEW critique/verdict against declared criteria, TEACH observable demonstration record shaped state -> human action -> observable consequence -> evidence, plus TOOL_GAP/KNOWLEDGE/EVALUATE), and A011 trajectory binding of observable work with a fail-closed private-chain-of-thought screen.
